summary: Improve purchasing data checks, spend analysis and supplier reporting. Practise spreadsheet methods and build a decision brief. Explore the course.
lede: Purchasing analytics helps procurement practitioners turn purchase-order, invoice, contract and supplier records into evidence for sourcing decisions. This course is for procurement analysts, spend analysts and procurement officers who need to clean and reconcile records, standardise supplier data, and compare spend using spreadsheets, pivot tables and KPIs. It also covers reviewing AI-assisted classifications and risk flags, and explaining data limitations in decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who work with purchasing records, supplier data and procurement decisions. It suits practitioners who need to produce consistent spend analysis and explain what the numbers can support.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with purchasing or procurement records is useful. No coding or programming is required; spreadsheet experience is helpful.
